summary: Expanded the universe around retail shrink and inventory accuracy using a two-lane funnel. Reference context comes from Zebra as a direct retail/RFID/inventory-accuracy platform vendor. The underfollowed discovery lane emphasizes Impinj as a RAIN RFID chip/platform dependency, Avery Dennison as the RFID/intelligent-label and source-tagging layer, and Riskified as a small-cap ecommerce fraud/returns-abuse software exposure. The key Serenity angle is that shrink and inventory accuracy are retailer margin problems, but the investable chokepoints may sit one or two layers upstream in tags, readers, item-level identity, labeling, and fraud-decisioning infrastructure.
